CSL/2024-25/430 
24th February, 2025 
 
To, 
BSE Limited 
Corporate Relationship Department 
1st Floor, New Trading Ring 
Rotunda Building, P J Towers 
Dalal Street, Fort, Mumbai – 400001. 
Scrip Code :532443 
Scrip ID: CERA 
To, 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Exchange Plaza 
Bandra Kurla Complex 
Bandra (East) 
Mumbai – 400051. 
 
Scrip Code: CERA 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 – Appointment in Senior 
Management 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that Mr. Ramesh Baliga 
has been appointed as ‘Chief Business Officer- Polymers and Emerging Business India’ w.e.f.24 th 
February, 2025. 
 
Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, and SEBI circulars dated 13 th 
July, 2023 is provided in Annexure I to this letter. 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you, 
For Cera Sanitaryware Limited, 
 
 
Hemal Sadiwala 
Company Secretary 
Encl: As above
